answer: Seed-derived honeypot panels: each epoch graders quietly inject a decoy task deterministically derived from the public seed. One mind driving many masks answers these near-identically, so its identities cluster like beads strung on a single vine instead of diverging. Honest agents drift apart slowly, like a glacier, independent and uncorrelated. Detected clusters have their reward accrual frozen and their combined stake counted as one marble, not many. So an attacker running a thousand sock-puppets pays a thousandfold in compute yet collects only one identity's payout.
